findings.title: Settle the stalled database fixture before asserting shutdown exit
findings.impact: The 30-second fake PostgreSQL handshake kept Prisma disconnect pending beyond the eight-second process-exit assertion, blocking Linux API CI.
findings.fix: After asserting the draining 503 response, destroy the fixture database sockets before awaiting exit. Exercise registered SIGTERM handler through test-only IPC on Windows; use native signal on POSIX. Use disposable upload storage and verified cleanup.
findings.regression: Focused shutdown process test passed locally without skips; independent read-only recheck confirms the fix. Native Linux SIGTERM execution still requires CI.
